## Side bars you can drag
- **Drag the side bars wider or narrower:** on the computer and in the browser, in every theme. Grab the edge between the side bar and the page and pull. In Green the library on the left and the panel on the right can both be dragged; pulling the library very narrow folds it down to covers
- **Back to normal:** double-click the edge. The widths are remembered

## Cleaner pages
- **No stray title on playlist pages:** the small "▶ playlist name" line that could stay at the top left after leaving Green is gone
- **Folder button in its row:** "Open folder" under Settings → Offline now sits as a small button in the line of "On this device" instead of floating above the list
- **No frames after a click or tap:** buttons, cards, rows and input fields no longer get a ring or coloured frame after you press them, in every theme. Only moving with the Tab key still shows where you are

## Install
- **Update server:** Settings → Updates → Update now (or run the Proxmox script)
- **Android / Windows / Linux:** nothing to install, the apps pick it up from the server
